title: College to Corporate IT Internship-Application Development (PA)
description:
Launch your career in technology with Vanguard’s College to Corporate (C2C) Internship Program. As an intern in this space, you’ll gain hands-on experience building and delivering impactful technology solutions that support our mission to give investors the best chance for success in areas such as web, mobile, and/or application development. This immersive internship combines real-world project work, mentorship, and structured development to help you grow your technical and professional skillset while building leadership skills through ownership of work, collaboration, and real-world impact. You'll build high-impact solutions that allow Vanguard to perform at its best and do what’s right for investors through exciting assignments.

In this internship, you will:

Design, build, and enhance applications that support Vanguard’s internal systems and client-facing platforms
Participate in the software development lifecycle, including coding, testing, debugging, and deployment
Work with modern technologies and tools in an Agile/LEAN team environment
Collaborate with engineers, product teams, and business partners to deliver impactful solutions
Contribute ideas, solve problems, and drive outcomes both independently and as part of a team
Build connections with peers, mentors, and leaders across Vanguard
Receive ongoing coaching and feedback to support your development

What it takes:

Pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (required)
Strong interest in application development, including web, mobile, or backend systems
Familiarity with one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript)
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
Demonstrated curiosity, initiative, and ability to learn in a fast-paced environment
Demonstrated leadership skills and/or leadership aspirations
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively
Cumulative GPA of 3.2 or higher (preferred)
undefined

Additional Information:

This is a full-time, paid 10-week summer internship
Vanguard does not offer visa sponsorship for this role
Start date: May/June 2027

Special Factors

Sponsorship

Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position.

About Vanguard

At Vanguard, we don't just have a mission—we're on a mission.

To work for the long-term financial wellbeing of our clients. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best.

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.
